lines.text: [excited] Power cut... and your Wi-Fi's gone? Not anymore!
Plug your router into one of these, and boom, you're still online.
You get twelve and nine volt outputs, plus five volt USB!
Routers, modems, IP cameras, LED lights... all covered.
Sixty to eighty watt-hours, and the slim ones? Just four hundred grams.
[excited] So what would YOU keep running? Drop it in the comments!
